reading_rule.title: Four questions before you believe it
subs: Any claim that a small fine-tuned model beat a big prompted one,
checked against six years of BANKING77 results.
rows: What did the big model get to see?

Names, examples, or hand-picked examples. GPT-4 scored 74.2% with three random examples per intent and 83.1% with three an expert chose (Loukas et al., 2023). In my trial, one written line per queue took Sonnet from 81.5% to 88.3%.
How many labels did the small one get?
Fine-tuned BERT scored 83.4% with 10 labelled messages per intent, 90.0% with 30, and 93.7% with all of them (Casanueva et al., 2020).
Who wrote the answers it learned from?
Preply's Qwen3.5-0.8B learned from GPT-5.4's annotations, checked and filtered first, then beat prompted GPT-5.4 on tests people had labelled (Celikik et al., 2026).
What happened after training day?
None of these studies changes the label set after training. In my trial, seven new queues cost the trained model all but 6 of their 280 messages.

result_foot: † Follow-up, pre-registered on 16 October after the first results.
* Exploratory, not pre-registered: Sonnet reads every message with the 77 names,
and its answer is used only when it names one of the seven new queues.

working_default.title: Who routes what
subs: A starting point for a contact-centre team, October 2026.
rows: Every queue
Write one line on what belongs there, from closed tickets, and give the list to the frontier model. Keep it current like any routing rule.
Queues with hundreds of past tickets
A fine-tuned small open model you store yourself. Its answer must be a name on the live queue list.
A queue added or renamed
Add its line to the frontier model's list the same day. That model's answer wins whenever it names a queue the small model was never trained on.
Unsure answers
Send the least confident few percent to the frontier model or a person, and check that handing over more still helps.
Retraining
From a fresh export, within a week of any queue change and at least monthly. Ship only if it beats the running model on last month's tickets.
Kill switch
Route everything through the frontier model if a weekly sample of routed tickets falls 3 points below launch accuracy, or a live queue has no training examples.
